title: prompt-manifest
description: What the prompt of one role step was made of (prompts/<step>.manifest.json beside <step>.md): its blocks in order with origin, digest and estimated tokens, the parts left out and why, and the digest and size of the whole prompt.

step.description: Step key of the prompt, such as scout, executor.1 or review.2.

role.description: Role id the prompt was made for.

route.description: Route of the role: the parts that were set.

blocks.description: Blocks of the prompt in order; their texts joined are the prompt.

excluded.description: Parts that were left out of the prompt.

estimated_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the whole prompt.

budgets.description: Estimated tokens of the blocks by class against their limits.

kind.description: What the block is: role_text, input, repository_rules, skill, skill_names, context_map, verification, run_rules, correction, answers, progress, result_contract, expected_paths, candidate, review_scope, diff, findings or instruction.

origin.description: Where the text came from: a role file, input.json, skill:<id>, scout-cache:<rel>, or conductor.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the block text (UTF-8), the separator that follows it included.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the block text.

id.description: Name of the thing the block stands for, such as a skill id.

excluded.description: A part left out of the prompt.

id.description: Name of the part, such as a skill id.

budget.description: Tokens of a class of blocks and its limit.
